review: Born 2024, Welcome back Suddenly One Day. Ring Yi Sang is an ID that utilizes negative status effects, meaning, he shines in Mirror Dungeon due to the amount of status effects the game mode has. Although without them he is still very good and can be put into any team. Ring Yi Sang skills normally roll 11 on S1, 16 on S2, and 15 on S3, but with conditions fulfilled numbers go up to 12/20/25 respectively. His passive helps him gain sanity very easily and on max sanity gain up 2 offense level per hit up to 8 offense level which translates to 2 more clash power on all of his skills. Now what counts as Negative Status you ask? In game this can be easily seen as Negative Status is written in a red text on the skills while Buffs are written in yellow on the skills tab meaning something like Cinq's Declared Duel and Butler Ryoshu's B.M. counts toward it.
